title: 第775章 巫神殿底蕴第774章 第四祭司陨落
slug: 打造万古家族开局奖励极道帝兵
lines: 在巫骨身死之际。
另一片天。
两股狂暴的气势正在高天上疯狂碰撞。
一位是南荒第二祭司，花玉。
一位则是楚州林氏的神府境大能，林赤炎。
第二祭司那双浑浊的眸子死死盯着林赤炎，眼中尽是寒意。
她怒声喝道：“林赤炎，你给我滚开！”
一身赤袍的林赤炎轻笑一声。
“第二祭司，今日有林某人在，你哪也去不了！”
第二祭司闻言。
气极反笑：“林赤炎，你好大的口气，想拦住老身，你怕是还没这个本事！”
“有没有这个本事，第二祭司试试不就知道了！”
林赤炎周身神火大盛，恍若一尊火神。
“既然你找死，那老身便成全你！”
第二祭司厉喝一声。
抓起手中的龙头木杖，便是向林赤炎攻了过去。
林赤炎毫不畏惧的迎了上去。
两尊神府后期大能，在高天上，展开了厮杀。
林赤炎炼的是火功。
对第二祭司的蛊毒有一定的克制作用。
但第二祭司的底蕴，实力摆在这。
别看她曾被楚王一击重创。
但楚王是何等人物？
第二祭司绝对是神府后期这个境界中顶尖的存在。
仅交手数十个回合。
林赤炎便落在了下风。
但林赤炎却不慌不忙。
他的任务，是只要牵制住第二祭司就够了。
他虽打不过第二祭司。
但第二祭司却也奈何不得他。
就在二人僵持之际。
一道流光，出现在了这片天空。
当流光散去，显露出面容。
赫然是南荒第五祭司岩魁。
只是此刻，岩魁满脸惊恐。
他看向正在与林赤炎激斗的第二祭司。
声音发颤道：“第二祭司...大...大事不好了，第四祭司的魂灯，彻底灭了！”
岩魁的话，如同一道惊雷，在第二祭司脑中炸响。
她那双浑浊的老眼，猛地瞪圆，眼中尽是难以置信。
“巫骨的魂灯彻底灭了？”
她那佝偻的身躯如筛糠一般剧烈的颤抖了起来。
她那双干枯的手死死攥着龙头木杖。
那眼神，恨不得要吃人！
content_en:
At the time of Wu Gu's death.
Another piece of sky.
Two violent momentums are colliding crazily in the sky.
One is the second priest of Southern Wilderness, Hua Yu.
One is Lin Chiyan, a powerful master of the Divine Palace Realm from the Lin family in Chuzhou.
The second priest's turbid eyes stared at Lin Chiyan, his eyes filled with coldness.
She shouted angrily: "Lin Chiyan, get out of here!"
Lin Chiyan, who was dressed in red robe, chuckled.
"Second Priest, if Lin is here today, you can't go anywhere!"
The second priest heard this.
He laughed angrily: "Lin Chiyan, you are so loud. You want to stop me. I'm afraid you don't have the ability yet!"
"If you have this ability, you will know if the second priest tries it!"
Lin Chiyan's body was filled with divine fire, like a god of fire.
"Since you are looking for death, I will help you!"
The second priest shouted sharply.
He grabbed the dragon-headed wooden stick in his hand and attacked Lin Chiyan.
Lin Chiyan stepped forward without fear.
Two late-stage powers from the Divine Palace started fighting in the sky.
Lin Chiyan practices fire skills.
It has a certain restraining effect on the poison of the second priest.
But the second priest’s background and strength lie here.
Don't look at the fact that she was severely injured by the King of Chu.
But what kind of person is the King of Chu?
The second priest is definitely the top existence in the later stage of the Divine Palace.
Only played dozens of rounds.
Lin Chiyan was at a disadvantage.
But Lin Chiyan was unhurried.
His mission is to contain the second priest.
Although he couldn't beat the second priest.
But the second priest couldn't do anything to him.
Just when the two were in a stalemate.
A stream of light appeared in the sky.
When the light dispersed, the face was revealed.
Astonishingly, it was Yan Kui, the fifth priest of the Southern Wilderness.
But at this moment, Yan Kui's face was full of panic.
He looked at the second priest who was fighting Lin Chiyan.
The voice trembled: "The second priest... big... something bad has happened. The soul lamp of the fourth priest has been completely extinguished!"
"What?!"
Yan Kui's words were like thunder, exploding in the second priest's mind.
Her cloudy old eyes suddenly widened, filled with disbelief.
"Is the Witch Bone's soul lamp completely extinguished?"
Her rickety body trembled violently like chaff.
Her withered hands tightly clutched the dragon-headed wooden stick.
That look in his eyes made him want to eat someone!
